where: Umbral Spire summit, the Keystar relight cutscene
mood: First True Dawn: the Keystar catches and the whole sky lights; the hometown motif stated whole in radiant major, triumphant with a tear in it.
core_styles: soaring warm pulse-wave lead singing the main theme in full
lush warm string chords and swelling pad
big joyful drums with crash cymbals

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {the light catches: a rising harp glissando and bell shimmer bloom out of a held note, a timpani swell and crash, and the lead rings out the first notes of the theme high and bright}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the main melody whole in radiant A major, a rising lift then a warm settle home, soaring over harp arpeggios and full strings}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same melody with the second lead harmonising in thirds and bells sparkling, the arrangement fuller and higher}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: tender and grateful, a turn through F sharp minor and D major, drums drop to soft brushes, strings remember the long night, then swell back toward home}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the melody returns in full triumph with crash cymbals; the last bar lifts on E straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
